User Guide

Use these pages after the quickstart when you need workflow-level guidance for real data preparation, training, and optional integrations.

Workflow pages

Tree input

Start from in-memory ETE trees or optional file readers.

Feature engineering

Attach deterministic numeric attributes to tree nodes.

Graph conversion

Convert feature-bearing trees into PyTorch Geometric graph data.

Training

Configure local model training, datasets, loaders, checkpoints, and outputs.

Metrics and tracking

Use built-in metrics and optional Weights & Biases logging.

How the pages fit
